sources.name: GaneshaSpeaks
sources.text: You will probably collect certain overdue payments in the afternoon. Later in the day, a gamble you took in business may pay rich dividends, expects Ganesha.

sources.name: Horoscope.com
sources.text: Some failures that you may have experienced over the past few days could have you beating yourself up today, Taurus. Perhaps you feel that you were too hasty or too sloppy and could have done things better. Don't obsess over it. Figure out what went wrong, learn from it, and let it go. Too much negativity directed at yourself is likely to sabotage future efforts rather than help them.

sources.name: Astrology.com
sources.text: Focus on hurdles that stand between you and your ultimate goals, dearest Taurus, hatching a plan to take them straight on. It's vital that you show up for yourself while the Libra Sun aligns with the nodes of fate and Chiron, even if the challenges you face are plentiful. Rather than fixating on how much work there is to be done, simply begin doing it. As the Pisces Moon aspects Venus rx and Uranus, having a strong support network is everything.

sources.name: AstroSage
sources.text: Your generous attitude would be a blessing in disguise as you are likely to be liberated from many vices like doubt, disloyalty, depression, lack of faith, greed, attachment, egoism, and jealousy. You should look twice at investment schemes that are presented to you today. Express your gratitude to the relatives who have helped you at the time of crisis. Your small gesture would lift their spirits. Secret affairs can ruin your reputation. Good day to send your resume or appear for an interview. Today, you will have free time on your hands, and you can use it to meditate. Therefore, you'll remain mentally at peace today. You might fight with your spouse today out of your own stress and actually of no reason.

readings.text: You are in a mood to achieve the most important task today. This is a perfect day to discuss the problems hindering success. The solutions you come up with will prove beneficial. Your positive attitude towards life will inspire people at the workplace, feels Ganesha.

The atmosphere calls for you to be social and outgoing. Smile when you encounter other people. This kind of mood will rub on others and get the week off to a very good start. Don't shrink into the background. Make a statement and reach out.

bits.t: Later in the day, a gamble you took in business may pay rich dividends, expects Ganesha.
Rather than fixating on how much work there is to be done, simply begin doing it.

readings.text: Ganesha feels that today you will be able to stay focused on business or work. There will be inclination towards increasing your business, or you will be able to contribute ably to your organization.

You would probably prefer not to have to worry about money, especially this week. But since it's a necessary part of life, you prefer to worry about broader things - that which you can't control. At this time, your money life is more ideas than reality, thanks to aspects happening in the area of your chart associated with past lives, institutions, the unconscious mind, and dreams. Your efforts to make any serious changes to your money situation now may need more time to develop.

bits.t: You should look twice at investment schemes that are presented to you today.

readings.text: Today you will be keeping good health. You may not face any major challenges on health front. There are chances of you focussing on development of work, for which you will have enough energy and focus both. It’s a good day from health angle.

You have a fun time under this favorable planetary atmosphere. You will enjoy reading and writing, find it easy to communicate with just about anyone, and find it equally difficult to get bored. However, don't let the important things slip during this brief period of wanderlust. Stay true to your health goals and exercise commitments. Life is a necessary combination of the sweet and bitter!

bits.t: You might fight with your spouse today out of your own stress and actually of no reason.

lucky.remedy: For a wonderful financial life, present books, educational and reading material to deserving people, academicians,scholars etc.

extras.title: Bonus
extras.text: Let go of one of your longest-held wishes and focus on creating bright, new ones.
